title: Netflix TV v1.2.6
changelog: Unblocked pristine direct 1080p HLS playback for The Notebook and all titles by removing false CDN keyword filtering
Completely eliminated 'Please Disable Sandbox' and 'This content cannot be embedded in a sandboxed frame' via universal document.domain polyfill and neutralization
Eliminated 'Playback Unavailable' watchdog overlay while video is actively playing in the background
Upgraded embed server pool to live endpoints: AutoEmbed.me and VidSrc.to (eliminating 404 Not Found and ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED)
Hardened in-app ad blocker to suppress gambling popups ('Claim your bonus!'), ad overlays, and robot verification prompts
Full D-Pad remote control support with dual time played & remaining on scrubber bar
